verdict.rationale: Evidence documents Snowflake shipping a managed MCP *server* that other AI agents can call to use Snowflake's Cortex tools (docs-14, docs-57), i.e., Snowflake acts as an MCP tool provider, not as a client consuming external MCP servers. There is no evidence that Snowflake's Cortex Agents or any Snowflake surface can plug in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, so the client-side capability the story asks for is unevidenced.
